annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes a Bitcoin-linked earning opportunity whose bonuses depend on recruiting people into left and right legs and funding progressively larger account tiers. It promises referral commissions, weekly residual income, and financial freedom while directing viewers to join and contact their referrer, making the recruitment-dependent structure the video's central solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video describes a multi-person binary hierarchy with left and right legs, spillover, downline levels, personal recruitment requirements, and bonuses that increase with funded account tiers. S03 is additionally supported because participation in the trading pool is presented as producing weekly profit-sharing and residual income.
